title.en: Build an Agent Harness from Zero

summary.zh-CN: 把一次模型调用变成有明确终止条件的循环。
summary.en: Turn one model call into a loop with an explicit stop condition.

summary.zh-CN: 建立后续所有章节共享的有界循环基线。
summary.en: Establish the bounded-loop baseline shared by every later lesson.

adds.zh-CN: 显式 session 生命周期与停止原因
adds.en: An explicit session lifecycle and stop reason

adds.zh-CN: Model 与 Harness 之间的 provider-neutral 边界
adds.en: A provider-neutral boundary between model and harness

preserves.zh-CN: 只记录可观察行为，不记录隐藏推理。
preserves.en: Record observable behavior, never hidden reasoning.

notes.zh-CN: 三份固定源码快照都提供了可核对的 Agent Loop 结构，但产品协议和恢复策略不同。
notes.en: Three pinned source snapshots expose inspectable agent-loop structures, while their product protocols and recovery policies differ.

acceptance.zh-CN: 提交的 JSONL 与示例真实运行完全一致，并通过 Trace Schema。
acceptance.en: The committed JSONL exactly matches a real demo run and passes the trace schema.

acceptance.zh-CN: 正常完成仍产生连续 sequence，并以 session.stop 结束。
acceptance.en: A completed run keeps contiguous sequence numbers and ends with session.stop.

summary.zh-CN: 把流式增量转换成可观察、可回放的事件。
summary.en: Convert streaming deltas into observable, replayable events.

summary.zh-CN: 保持同一循环，把单次响应改造成有序的 streaming delta。
summary.en: Keep the same loop while turning one response into ordered streaming deltas.

adds.zh-CN: 累积文本与最终 chunk 标记
adds.en: Accumulated text and an explicit final-chunk marker

preserves.zh-CN: 一次模型 turn 最终仍只追加一条 assistant message。
preserves.en: One model turn still appends exactly one assistant message.

notes.zh-CN: 对照重点是事件边界和可消费协议，不把 UI 流式效果误当成内部事件模型。
notes.en: The comparison focuses on event boundaries and consumable protocols, not on inferring internals from streaming UI behavior.

acceptance.zh-CN: 三个 delta 形成三个有序事件，且最后一个明确标记 final。
acceptance.en: Three deltas produce three ordered events and the last is explicitly final.

acceptance.zh-CN: 增量可回放，同时不会污染下一轮的消息历史。
acceptance.en: Deltas remain replayable without polluting the next-turn message history.

summary.zh-CN: 验证、执行并记录模型请求的工具调用。
summary.en: Validate, execute, and record model-requested tool calls.

summary.zh-CN: 在不改变循环所有权的前提下加入结构化 Tool Roundtrip。
summary.en: Add a structured tool roundtrip without changing ownership of the loop.

adds.en: Tool registry, argument validation, and dispatch

adds.zh-CN: tool.request 与 tool.result 的可追踪配对
adds.en: Traceable pairing of tool.request and tool.result

preserves.zh-CN: 模型只能请求动作；Harness 决定是否以及如何执行。
preserves.en: The model only requests actions; the harness decides whether and how to execute them.

notes.zh-CN: Vendor 源码 Claim 与可复现 reference baseline 分开呈现；后者不是 Native Agent 证据。
notes.en: Vendor source claims are shown separately from the reproducible reference baseline, which is not native-agent evidence.

acceptance.zh-CN: request、result 与第二次模型请求按因果顺序出现。
acceptance.en: The request, result, and second model request appear in causal order.

acceptance.zh-CN: 工具结果以绑定 tool_call_id 的 tool message 返回下一轮。
acceptance.en: The tool result returns to the next turn as a tool message bound to tool_call_id.

summary.zh-CN: 为副作用工具建立工作区路径边界和显式 allowlist。
summary.en: Put workspace boundaries and explicit allowlists around side-effecting tools.

summary.zh-CN: 把抽象工具替换为受工作区边界约束的真实文件副作用。
summary.en: Replace an abstract tool with real file effects constrained by a workspace boundary.

adds.zh-CN: 路径规范化、逃逸拒绝与显式工具 allowlist
adds.en: Path normalization, escape rejection, and an explicit tool allowlist

adds.zh-CN: 可处置 fixture 中的真实文件读取
adds.en: A real file read inside a disposable fixture

preserves.zh-CN: 工具 Schema 校验不能替代权限与执行边界。
preserves.en: Tool-schema validation does not replace permissions or execution boundaries.

notes.zh-CN: 这些 Claim 证明相邻的 approval/sandbox 边界；它们不等同于本章教学用的 Path.resolve 实现。
notes.en: These claims establish adjacent approval and sandbox boundaries; they do not imply the agents use this lesson's Path.resolve implementation.

acceptance.zh-CN: Golden Trace 只包含 fixture 内的相对路径与干净结果。
acceptance.en: The Golden Trace contains only a fixture-relative path and a clean result.

acceptance.zh-CN: ../ 逃逸在任何文件操作发生前被拒绝。
acceptance.en: A ../ escape is rejected before any filesystem operation occurs.

summary.zh-CN: 从工作区根目录到当前目录组合分层指令。
summary.en: Compose hierarchical instructions from the workspace root to the current directory.

summary.zh-CN: 在模型请求前加入可审计、从根到叶组合的项目指令。
summary.en: Compile auditable root-to-leaf project instructions before the model request.

adds.zh-CN: 有界目录遍历与分层 instruction discovery
adds.en: Bounded directory traversal and layered instruction discovery

adds.zh-CN: 来源可见、顺序稳定的 system prompt 组合

preserves.zh-CN: 项目指令仍由 Harness 发现和编译，而不是由模型自行搜索。
preserves.en: Project instructions are still discovered and compiled by the harness, not searched for ad hoc by the model.

notes.zh-CN: 当前固定 Snapshot 尚无达到本项目证据标准的 instruction precedence Claim；网页必须把它显示为研究缺口，而不是猜测实现。
notes.en: Current pinned snapshots do not yet have an instruction-precedence claim at this project's evidence standard; the site must show that research gap instead of guessing.

acceptance.zh-CN: 运行与提交的 Trace 一致，且不泄露本地绝对路径。
acceptance.en: The run matches the committed trace without leaking a local absolute path.

acceptance.zh-CN: 根级指令稳定出现在 package 级指令之前，外部 cwd 被拒绝。
acceptance.en: Root instructions remain before package instructions and an external cwd is rejected.

summary.zh-CN: 让输入裁剪和工具输出截断成为可见策略。
summary.en: Make input pruning and tool-output truncation explicit policies.

summary.zh-CN: 让有限上下文中的截断与裁剪成为显式、可回放的 Harness 策略。
summary.en: Turn truncation and pruning in a finite context window into explicit, replayable harness policy.

adds.zh-CN: 单工具输出上限与全局输入预算
adds.en: A per-tool-output limit and a global input budget

adds.zh-CN: context.prune 事件与可见的信息损失
adds.en: context.prune events and visible information loss

preserves.zh-CN: 完整事实记录与每轮模型可见投影保持分离。
preserves.en: The complete factual record remains separate from each model-visible projection.

notes.zh-CN: 这些固定源码 Claim 覆盖更高级的 compaction；本章只实现确定性 truncation/pruning，因此不能把两者当作同一机制。
notes.en: These pinned source claims cover more advanced compaction; this lesson implements deterministic truncation and pruning, so the mechanisms must not be treated as identical.

acceptance.zh-CN: Trace 同时证明 oversized result 被截断，下一次请求前发生 context.prune。
acceptance.en: The trace proves both oversized-result truncation and context.prune before the next request.

acceptance.zh-CN: 单结果上限与历史裁剪独立生效，并产生结构化观测事件。
acceptance.en: Per-result limiting and history pruning act independently and emit structured observations.

title.en: Session Event Logs, Replay, and Branching

summary.zh-CN: 从 append-only 事件重建派生状态，并创建保留 lineage 的分支。
summary.en: Rebuild derived state from append-only events and create lineage-preserving branches.

summary.zh-CN: 把 Trace 从观察输出提升为可重建状态和 lineage 的事实日志。
summary.en: Promote the trace from observation output to a factual log that can rebuild state and lineage.

adds.zh-CN: 严格 sequence、单 session/run 的 append-only SessionJournal
adds.en: An append-only SessionJournal with strict sequence and one session/run identity

adds.zh-CN: 确定性 replay projection、fingerprint 与 parent-preserving branch
adds.en: Deterministic replay projections, fingerprints, and parent-preserving branches

preserves.zh-CN: 原始事件保持不可变；replay view 和 branch 都是派生产物。
preserves.en: Raw events remain immutable; replay views and branches are derived artifacts.

notes.zh-CN: 固定源码 Claim 证明三种事件/会话记录边界；本章的 ReplayState 与 SessionBranch 是教学协议，不声称复制任一产品格式。
notes.en: Pinned source claims establish three event/session recording boundaries; the lesson's ReplayState and SessionBranch are teaching protocols, not copies of any product format.

acceptance.zh-CN: 同一运行稳定地产生 replay fingerprint 和指向 sequence 2 的 branch。
acceptance.en: The same run produces a stable replay fingerprint and a branch at sequence 2.

acceptance.zh-CN: 缺口 sequence、混合 run 或越界 fork 都被拒绝，父日志不被改写。
acceptance.en: Gapped sequences, mixed runs, and out-of-range forks are rejected without rewriting the parent log.

summary.zh-CN: 用带 provenance 的语义 checkpoint 替换过长历史，同时保留原始事实日志。
summary.en: Replace long visible history with a provenance-bearing semantic checkpoint while retaining the factual log.

summary.zh-CN: 在可重放事实日志之上，为下一轮模型编译更小的语义 checkpoint。
summary.en: Compile a smaller semantic checkpoint for the next model turn on top of a replayable factual log.

adds.zh-CN: 显式 trigger、可注入 summarizer 与 recent-tail 策略
adds.en: An explicit trigger, injectable summarizer, and recent-tail policy

adds.zh-CN: context.compact 事件、source fingerprint 与 before/after 大小
adds.en: A context.compact event with source fingerprint and before/after size

preserves.zh-CN: 摘要只是模型可见投影，不能覆盖或替代原始 SessionJournal。
preserves.en: A summary is only a model-visible projection and never overwrites the original SessionJournal.

notes.zh-CN: 三个固定源码 Snapshot 都有直接 compaction Claim；比较时仍区分触发阈值、保留 tail、缓存与恢复语义。
notes.en: All three pinned source snapshots have direct compaction claims; comparison still separates trigger thresholds, retained tails, caching, and resume semantics.

acceptance.zh-CN: 第二次模型请求前出现 context.compact，且 final_chars 小于 original_chars。
acceptance.en: context.compact appears before the second model request and final_chars is below original_chars.

acceptance.zh-CN: 模型收到 compacted checkpoint，Trace 保留被压缩范围的稳定 SHA-256。
acceptance.en: The model receives a compacted checkpoint and the trace retains a stable SHA-256 for the compacted range.

summary.zh-CN: 把长期事实与完整能力说明移出常驻上下文，只在相关时检索和加载。
summary.en: Move durable facts and full capability instructions out of resident context, retrieving them only when relevant.

summary.zh-CN: 从“压缩旧上下文”前进到“按需取回外部事实与能力说明”。
summary.en: Move from compressing old context to retrieving external facts and capability instructions on demand.

adds.zh-CN: 带 scope/source 的 MemoryRecord 与确定性 retrieval
adds.en: Source- and scope-attributed MemoryRecord objects with deterministic retrieval

adds.zh-CN: 轻量 descriptor 常驻、完整 skill instructions 延迟加载
adds.en: Resident lightweight descriptors with lazily loaded full skill instructions

preserves.zh-CN: 检索与加载都通过可观察事件进入上下文，不把外部数据伪装成模型记忆。
preserves.en: Retrieval and loading enter context through observable events; external data is never disguised as model memory.

notes.zh-CN: Claim 直接覆盖 skills/plugins/hooks 或 lazy extension runtime，但当前没有统一的跨产品 durable-memory 语义，因此 Memory 部分保持相邻映射。
notes.en: The claims directly cover skills, plugins, hooks, or lazy extension runtimes, but no uniform cross-product durable-memory semantics are established, so the memory portion remains an adjacent mapping.

acceptance.zh-CN: memory.read 和 skill.load 各出现一次，并且结果带 source 或 skill identity。
acceptance.en: memory.read and skill.load each appear once with source or skill identity.

acceptance.zh-CN: 查询只返回相关、带来源的 memory；未知 skill 明确失败，不静默注入。
acceptance.en: Queries return only relevant source-attributed memory; unknown skills fail explicitly rather than being silently injected.
